		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_evaluator
				var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_raw > 0
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_evaluator = {
						OR = {
					AND = {
						has_variable = zg361_b1_peer_slot_1_evaluator
						has_variable = zg361_b1_peer_slot_1_raw
						trigger_if = {
							limit = {
								has_variable = zg361_b1_peer_slot_1_evaluator
								has_variable = zg361_b1_peer_slot_1_raw
							}
							var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_1_raw > 0
							var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_1_evaluator = scope:zg361_b1_peer_subject
						}
						trigger_else = { always = no }
					}
					AND = {
						has_variable = zg361_b1_peer_slot_2_evaluator
						has_variable = zg361_b1_peer_slot_2_raw
						trigger_if = {
							limit = {
								has_variable = zg361_b1_peer_slot_2_evaluator
								has_variable = zg361_b1_peer_slot_2_raw
							}
							var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_2_raw > 0
							var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_2_evaluator = scope:zg361_b1_peer_subject
						}
						trigger_else = { always = no }
					}
					AND = {
						has_variable = zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_evaluator
						has_variable = zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_raw
						trigger_if = {
							limit = {
								has_variable = zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_evaluator
								has_variable = zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_raw
							}
							var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_raw > 0
							var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_evaluator = scope:zg361_b1_peer_subject
						}
						trigger_else = { always = no }
					}
						}
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_reciprocal value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_peer_reciprocity_risk value = 1 }
				set_variable = {
					name = zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_weight
					value = { value = var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_weight multiply = 0.5 floor = yes min = 10 }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_adjusted value = var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_raw }
		var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_evaluator = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zg361_b1_evaluator_profile_id } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_profile_id value = scope:zg361_b1_peer_subject.var:zg361_b1_case_serial }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_history_n value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_history_sum value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_history_sum_squares value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_history_mean value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_history_variance value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_overturn_n value = 0 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_history_n add = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_history_sum add = scope:zg361_b1_peer_subject.var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_raw }
			set_variable = {
				name = zg361_b1_evaluator_history_current_square
				value = { value = scope:zg361_b1_peer_subject.var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_raw multiply = scope:zg361_b1_peer_subject.var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_raw }
			}
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_history_sum_squares add = var:zg361_b1_evaluator_history_current_square }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_history_mean value = { value = var:zg361_b1_evaluator_history_sum divide = var:zg361_b1_evaluator_history_n } }
			set_variable = {
				name = zg361_b1_evaluator_history_variance
				value = {
					value = var:zg361_b1_evaluator_history_sum_squares
					divide = var:zg361_b1_evaluator_history_n
					subtract = { value = var:zg361_b1_evaluator_history_mean multiply = var:zg361_b1_evaluator_history_mean }
					min = 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_statistics_cycle value = scope:zg361_b1_peer_subject.var:zg361_b1_cycle_serial }
			scope:zg361_b1_peer_subject = {
				set_variable = {
					name = zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_adjusted
					value = { value = var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_raw subtract = { value = prev.var:zg361_b1_evaluator_history_mean multiply = 0.2 } max = 10 min = -15 }
				}
			}
		}
		change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_peer_n add = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_peer_raw_sum add = var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_raw }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_peer_adjusted_sum add = var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_adjusted }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_peer_credit_total add = var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_weight }
		set_variable = {
			name = zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_weighted
			value = { value = var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_adjusted multiply = var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_weight }
		}
		change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_peer_weighted_sum add = var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_weighted }
		set_variable = {
			name = zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_square
			value = { value = var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_raw multiply = var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_raw }
		}
		change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_peer_sum_squares add = var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_square }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_sealed_serial value = var:zg361_b1_case_serial }
		var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_evaluator = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zg361_b1_evaluator_credit } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_credit value = 100 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_sample_n value = 0 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_sample_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_raw >= 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_b1_evidence_late >= 0 }
				var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_evaluator = { change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_credit add = 2 } }
			}
			else = { var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_evaluator = { change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_credit add = -5 } } }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_b1_evidence_late < 0 }
				var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_evaluator = { change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_credit add = 2 } }
			}
			else = { var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_evaluator = { change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_credit add = -5 } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_reciprocal = 1 }
			var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_evaluator = { change_variable = { name = zg361_b1_evaluator_credit add = -3 } }
		}
		var:zg361_b1_peer_slot_3_evaluator = {
			set_variable = {
				name = zg361_b1_evaluator_credit
				value = { value = var:zg361_b1_evaluator_credit max = 125 min = 25 }
			}
		}
	}
}
